title: OpenAI judge schema 400: rubric not in required
description:
## Intent

Live OpenAI structured output rejects the judge schema.

## Repro

`limatus scan --require-judge` against a profile with `judge.provider: openai` returns:

Invalid schema for response_format `editorial_judge_scan`: `required` must include every key in properties. Missing `rubric`.

`_judge_output_schema` in editorial_judge.py lists `rubric` in properties but `required` is only `findings`.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Judge schema is OpenAI-strict
  As a copy-editing agent
  I want the judge Responses API schema to list every property in required
  So live Terra judge can run

  Scenario: Schema includes rubric
    Given the judge output schema
    Then required includes findings and rubric
```
